title: Completed stalks on the closed fibre after completion of the base
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and let $C=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}A/\mathfrak m^n$ be its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum] and let $p:Y=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}C\to X$ be the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. For a point $y\in Y$, put $x=p(y)$ and assume $f(x)=\mathfrak m$. Write $\mathfrak n_x$ and $\mathfrak n_y$ for the maximal ideals of the local rings $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$. The local homomorphism $p_y^\sharp:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] induces an isomorphism of rings $$\varprojlim_{n\ge1}\mathcal O_{X,x}/\mathfrak n_x^n\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ \varprojlim_{n\ge1}\mathcal O_{Y,y}/\mathfrak n_y^n.$$ No finite-type or properness assumption is imposed on $X$.
